versions.changelog:
Initial release of material-to-prd skill.

- Defines the role as a senior internet product manager/PRD expert with clear boundaries and scope.
- Implements a rigorous workflow: material parsing via OCR, business logic structuring, and strict PRD generation following a fixed template.
- Ensures all output content is grounded only in provided user materials; no invented or extrapolated content is permitted.
- Mandates output in standard Markdown, with a top-of-document copy/save instruction for review and archiving.
- Enforces strict, professional, and developer-ready standards in all generated PRD documents.
